interface.name: rix_capture_policy_manager_v1
interface.description:
This extension lets a client exclude its own surfaces from captures made by the compositor. Excluded surfaces remain visible on physical outputs. Output captures reveal the scene underneath them; an excluded toplevel cannot be selected as a window capture source.
Exclusion covers compositor screenshots, screencasts and thumbnails, including their cursor surfaces. It is inherited by subsurfaces and xdg popups, but not by independently created toplevels. It does not protect against cameras, direct device access or capture outside the compositor. This is a compositor extension, not a standard Wayland protocol.

entry.name: already_exists
entry.summary: surface already has a policy object

request.name: get_surface

description.summary: Create a policy object for a surface

request.description: Only one live policy object may exist for a wl_surface at a time. Creating the object does not change the surface's capture policy.

interface.name: rix_capture_policy_surface_v1
interface.description: The default policy is include. Policy changes take effect atomically with wl_surface.commit, including synchronized subsurface transactions. A client should set exclude before committing its first sensitive buffer and wait for applied before relying on exclusion. Only the last set_policy request in a committed transaction needs to be acknowledged.

entry.name: include
entry.summary: allow capture unless inherited exclusion applies

entry.name: exclude
entry.summary: exclude this surface and its children from capture

request.name: destroy
request.description: The last committed policy persists for the lifetime of the wl_surface. Destroying this object must not accidentally expose a sensitive buffer. To allow capture again, explicitly commit include before destroying it, or create a new policy object and commit include through that object. Already committed synchronized transactions are not cancelled.

arg.name: serial
arg.summary: client token echoed when the change takes effect

event.name: applied

description.summary: The committed policy is now enforced

event.description: The serial identifies the applied request. The policy is the surface's own committed value; include cannot override an ancestor's exclusion. Frames captured before this transaction are not revoked.
